newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey plans to export 50,000 tonnes sugar.
newsitem.headline: Turkey plans to export 50,000 tonnes sugar.

text.p: Turkey's state-run sugar refinery Turkseker is planning to export 50,000 tonnes of sugar soon, its general manager Selahhatin Hun said on Tuesday.
"We are planning to sell about 50,000 tonnes more after our first sale two weeks ago," Hun told Reuters.
He said Turkseker did not plan to open a tender but the sale would be through bilateral export accords. He did not give any other details.
At a farmers' meeting in Ankara on Tuesday, Industry Minister Yalim Erez reiterated an earlier prediction that Turkey's sugar output would be 1.85 million tonnes in 1996/97.
Turkey earlier said it was considering sugar sales to Iran, Azerbaijan and Georgia.
